post.caption:
A barrel of oil is not mostly petrol. It becomes diesel, jet fuel, lubricants, asphalt, plastics, medicines and textiles. The biggest and least-named product is fertiliser: the Haber-Bosch process pulls nitrogen out of the air using enormous heat and pressure, that heat comes from fossil fuel, and that fertiliser grows roughly half the world's food. Which means about half the nitrogen atoms in your body arrived through an industrial plant.
